title: Gitleaf doc frontmatter (gitleaf/doc@1)
description: Optional YAML frontmatter of a Markdown doc. Key order in this schema is the canonical serialization order. Unknown keys are allowed only under the x- prefix.

schema.description: Schema marker. Optional for docs; when present it must be gitleaf/doc@1.

id.description: Stable identity that survives file moves. <TYPE>-<8 Crockford base32 chars>.

owners.description: People or teams responsible for the doc. Handles, emails or team names.

review_by.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) after which the doc counts as stale unless reviewed.

^x-.description: Extension keys. Gitleaf preserves them and never interprets them.
